description: The bar chart compares the performance of three models—RedWhale (our), EEVE-Korean-10.8B-v1.0, and SOLAR-10.7B-v1.0 (base)—across six evaluation categories: PT-EVAL, KoBEST-BQ, KoBEST-CP, KoBEST-HS, KoBEST-SN, and AVG. The vertical axis represents performance scores, with values ranging from approximately 0.42 to 1.00. For each category, three bars are displayed: a dark purple bar for RedWhale (our), a light blue bar for EEVE-Korean-10.8B-v1.0, and a gray bar for SOLAR-10.7B-v1.0 (base). In all categories, the SOLAR-10.7B-v1.0 (base) model achieves a score of 1.00, serving as the baseline. RedWhale (our) consistently outperforms EEVE-Korean-10.8B-v1.0 across all categories, with scores of 0.42 (PT-EVAL), 0.52 (KoBEST-BQ), 0.71 (KoBEST-CP), 0.50 (KoBEST-HS), 0.69 (KoBEST-SN), and 0.57 (AVG). The EEVE-Korean-10.8B-v1.0 model shows lower performance, with scores of 0.46 (PT-EVAL), 0.56 (KoBEST-BQ), 0.74 (KoBEST-CP), 0.54 (KoBEST-HS), 0.73 (KoBEST-SN), and 0.61 (AVG). The average performance (AVG) for RedWhale (our) is 0.57, while for EEVE-Korean-10.8B-v1.0 it is 0.61, indicating that EEVE-Korean-10.8B-v1.0 slightly outperforms RedWhale (our) on average, despite RedWhale (our) having higher scores in most individual categories.
